$comment: Every reusable engine of the FAN LIFE universe. IDENTICAL in every repo (fanlife, Offsides, Dubid, The-Worker, FuckYou), like contract.json. Read it before designing a feature: if the engine exists, reuse it through its owner, never fork it. A pull request that ships a reusable engine adds or refreshes its row here and copies the same bytes to the other repos in the same round.

howToReuse.data: Read through schema shared/core views and RPCs (contract rules 1, 8, 13). Never read another app's tables.
howToReuse.link: createHandoff() from ecosystem/sdk.ts with the contract moment; the target reports shared.handoff_outcome.
howToReuse.code-in-another-repo: Ask the owner repo to expose it (route, RPC, published file under ecosystem/). Copying source across repos is a fork and is not allowed; ecosystem/ is the only folder that is the same bytes everywhere.
